comparison: Previous source-5b244ea controlled restart required about 103 seconds. Source-90 reached health=200 in the first post-kickstart poll window (<1s upper bound at this measurement precision); do not interpret this as an exact zero-second duration.
conclusion: Controlled restart of the authorized com.macbot.server LaunchAgent succeeded in the first health poll window; selected waiting/jobs/takeovers counts and hashes were unchanged. No model run or other process was touched.

startup_measurement.script: inline shell command in integrator turn; no standalone script was created
startup_measurement.method: after launchctl kickstart returned, poll pgrep for /Applications/MacBotServer.app/Contents/MacOS/macbotd and curl http://127.0.0.1:7788/api/v1/health once per second; record first PID/HTTP 200 transition
startup_measurement.precision: both process start and ready timestamp are only second-resolution; evidence supports same-second readiness (<1s upper bound from the first poll window), not an exact 0.000s duration
